runner: run_lerobot_libero.py (LeRobot policy, processors, LIBERO env and rollout loop)
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: LeRobot port (lerobot org) of VLA-JEPA, run as the LeRobot vla_jepa docs' lerobot-eval command (no overrides): chunk 7 / n_action_steps 7, 4 flow-matching steps, LeRobot's 360 px observations resized to 224 by the processor, step limits 280/280/300/520, 10 no-op steps. The docs report 95/100/98/93 on 100 episodes per suite. Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct and facebook/vjepa2-vitl-fpc64-256 read from local folders.
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
